title: Projection self inner product bound
statement: Let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ and let $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$. If $P_Jf(x)$ denotes the average of $f$ over inputs agreeing with $x$ on $J$, then the uniform inner product of $P_Jf$ with itself is at most the uniform average of $|P_Jf|$ over the cube.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a subset of the coordinates
